response.justification: While the candidate exceeds the required 15 years of experience and demonstrates strong full-stack technical capabilities, they lack the specialized AI strategy expertise that is central to this role. Recent AI infrastructure work is a positive signal, but there is no demonstrated expertise in building AI products, platforms, or providing strategic advisory on AI adoption. The resume shows solid IC progression but the core AI specialization required for this Principal Engineer role is missing.
strengths: Exceeds 15-year requirement with approximately 20 years of diverse technical experience across platforms and domains
Recent exposure to AI infrastructure (MCP, AI agents) demonstrates emerging engagement with AI technologies
Strong mentorship and teaching background demonstrates ability to inspire and communicate technical concepts effectively
concerns: No demonstrated recognized expertise in AI or proven track record of building AI-powered products or platforms
Career background is generalist software engineering rather than specialized AI strategy or technical leadership
Limited evidence of strategic advisory experience with enterprise customers on cloud or AI technology adoption

key_factors.factor: Strong technical IC progression and teaching ability
